# Gate G2's seed ensemble (design/adr/0003-simulation-oracle.md point 9; owner,
# 2026-11-19, 60 seeds). Each listed scenario of CppSource/Oracle/scenarios runs once
# per seed on both sides: the oracle as `Oracle.exe sim <data root> <scenario> <out>\seed_<S>\<name>
# --seed S` (data.yml, "Run the seed ensemble"), the Rust world in scenario_replay's
# `g2_seed_ensemble` test. The seed replaces the one of the srand the harness calls again
# once the system and Content's population have loaded (reference-build.md section 10,
# start-up step 5); the load-time draws keep the scenario's seed.
#
# The seeds: the scenario default 0x4f524143 (1330790723), then 0x4f524143 + k x
# 0x9e3779b9 (mod 2^32) for k = 1..59, so that no two seeds are close (the CRT's first
# draw from a seed is nearly linear in it). Fixed: change the list only with a new
# revision of record 0003.

scenario fly_to_point
scenario fire_at_target
scenario ram_ship
scenario dogfight
scenario skirmish
scenario strafe
